exposure: Narakas Grade I to II injury
finding: This study identified several peripartum/neonatal factors that significantly altered the odds of having persistent NBPP at 1 year, including cephalic presentation, induction or augmentation of labor, birth weight > 9 lbs, and the presence of Horner syndrome, which increased the odds, while cesarean delivery and Narakas Grade I to II injury reduced the odds.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery significantly reduced the odds of persistent NBPP at 1 year.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was assessed, with birth weight > 9 lbs significantly increasing the odds of persistent NBPP at 1 year
